# Red Checker

> An AI assistant loaded with the Constitution, Acts of Parliament and public policies of the Republic of Malawi. Ask a question in plain language and get an answer with the specific section cited.

Red Checker is intended for the general public in Malawi. It is not a substitute for a licensed legal practitioner but helps people understand their rights, obligations, and the workings of Malawian law.
